intent.instructions: Classify only the meaning of the Russian teacher wish. Interpret negation literally. Ignore whether the wish is allowed by the profile. Answer this question independently of all other questions.

criteria.available_time: Teacher wants or is available to teach at a named day and period.
criteria.unavailable_time: Teacher cannot or does not want to teach at a named day and period.
criteria.avoid_consecutive: Teacher wants to avoid consecutive lessons.
criteria.room_capability: Teacher requests specific room software or equipment.
criteria.other: No listed intent or ambiguous intent.

disposition.instructions: Decide disposition using the supplied policy, the wish and authorized context. Do not invent assignments or constraints. Answer independently of the intent question.

criteria.propose: A supported soft wish grounded in the supplied domain; no contradiction of hard profile constraints.
criteria.review_profile: Requested teaching time contradicts hard profile unavailability.
criteria.review_ambiguous: Consecutive wish cannot identify one assigned requirement or its meaning is ambiguous.
criteria.review_unsupported: Room capability, avoiding consecutive lessons, unsupported count or missing catalog period requires review.
